content: 'Ũxohix yã yãy putuk
'Ũkxape xop, 'ãkuxa mãm ka'ok yũmũg xuxyã Yeyox Kunnix kopah, ha' max xe'ẽgnãg, yĩ' hok xop xix 'ũp-texop xexka putup pax, yã' nõy putuk yũmũg xuxyã pu'.

Pa tikmũ'ũn yãg te' hok xop putup nõg, tup-texop xexka putup pax, hap-texop te 'ãxop mũtik yãy tu nũ'nãhã' tu' xax max mõ'tat, tu pipkup kõnãmõg tat yĩpkutok hã', ha tik hok nũn, kamah, tu' xax kummuk mõ'tat.
Pe 'ãxop tep-texop pu: “Yũhũm, nũy nũ mĩpe max yĩmũ yũm,” kaxĩy. Tu' hok pu: Pe yĩy 'ãknĩhã xihip 'õnte', pe yã hãm tu yũhũm,” kaxĩy.
Puxi', 'ãp-tox 2 'ãnõy hã, yã 'ãxop hã yãy putuk 'ohnãg.
'Ũkxape xop, 'ũg'ãpax: Topa te' hok xop yĩmõgãtux, pu' kuxa mãm ka'ok hamũn kopah, nũy yĩpkox pi', 'ĩhã Topa te' xat, Topap-tup pax tu', yã Topa te hãm'ãktux xex nõm xop mũtik,
ha 'ãxop te' hok xop putup nõg, pãyã putexop xexka te xa hãpkummugãhã', tu tik pa te hãmyũmmũg ha 'ãmõgãhã', nũy 'ãkupeh,
tu Yeyox Kunnix 'ãktux kummuk, ha xa' hõm yãy'ãxet'ax. Hap-texop te xa 'ãktux kummuk, ha Topa te xa hãmmaxnaha'.
'Ãxat'ax pu yĩpkox pi', puxix hãpxopmã max, ha' xat, hu: “'Ãnõy putup pax, xate yãy mũn putup pax putuk,” kaxĩy.
'Ãxop te hãmhok xop putup nõg, xip-texop putup pax, 'ũxax pẽnã tu', puxix Topa yõg xat'ax pu 'ãyĩpkox pip hok, tu hãpkummuk mĩy, ha Topa te' kummuk 'ãktux.
Tikmũ'ũn te Topa yõg xat'ax puxehnãg pu' yĩpkox hok, puxix tu xat'ax xohix pu' yĩpkox 'ohnãg. Yã Topa te' xat, pu' xat'ax xohix pu' yĩpkox pi'.
Ha' xat, hu: 'Ãxonnix hok,” kaxĩy. Tu xe: “'Ũp-tex hok,” kaxĩy. 'Ap xatep-tex'ah, pãyã' xonnix, puxix 'ãyĩpkox hok, tu' xat'ax koxyõy.
Topa te 'õg hãpxopmã'ax kopit'ax, yĩ' xat'ax pu 'ãyĩpkox pi'. Yã' xat'ax te yũmũ'ã hãmyũmmũgãhã', 'ũyĩy yũmũg hi xe'e', nũy hãpxopmã max.

Topa te tikmũ'ũn yõg hãpxopmã'ax xohix kopit putup, ha tikmũ'ũn te' nõy kuxa ka hok, puxix Topa' ka hok xop kuxa ka hok 'ũyãnãn tu', pa tikmũ'ũn te' nõy kuxa ka', puxix Topa te nõm xop pu hãpkummugã hok.
'Ãkuxa yũm ka'ok nũy hãpxopmã max
'Ũkxape xop, 'ã' max'ah, yãy kuxa yũm'ax 'ãktux, 'ĩhã 'ãnõy te 'õg hãpxopmã max pẽnã 'ohnãg. Yã 'ãkuxa yũm pu'uk, 'ap 'ãkuxa yũm xe'e'ah.
'Ãxape xax kummuk, ha putup tep-tex,
ha tu hãpxop hõm 'ohnãg, xix topixxax hõm 'ohnãg, pa: “Pũyã Topa xa hãmmaxnã', xayĩy 'ãxit max, nũy 'ãxax max tat kamah,” kaxĩy,
puxix 'ãkuxa yũm pu'uk, 'ĩhã 'ãnõy pu hãpxopmã 'ohnãg, 'ap 'ãkuxa yũm xe'e'ah.

Tikmũ'ũn te: “'Ãkuxa yũm ka'ok, ha 'ãte hãpxopmã max,” kaxĩy. Yĩy 'ãte: Tikmũ'ũn te 'ãkuxa yũm'ax pẽnã hok, 'ĩhã xate hãpxopmã 'ohnãg. Pãyã 'ãte hãpxopmã max'ax hã xa' mũg, xayĩy pẽnã', nũy tuk kuxa yũm ka'ok yũmmũg. Yã hãpxopmã'ax max hã tikmũ'ũn te' pẽnã'ax,” kaxĩy.
'Ok 'ãkuxa yũm ka'ok Topap-xehnãg kopah? Yã' max. Yãmĩy kummuk xop kuxa mãm ka'ok kamah, tu Topa yĩpkutuk, tu yãy nuhuknãm 'ũkuxãnõg tu'.
'Ãptox ka'ok, tu hãmyũmmũg 'ohnãg! 'Ãkuxa yũm ka'ok, 'ĩhã hãpxopmã max 'ohnãg, tu' hitop hã 'ãkuxa yũm, 'ap puxi'ah.
Tep te xĩy Topa te mõnãyxop hittap 'Amanãm max 'ãktux? 'Amanãm tek-tok 'Iyak hõm'ax, nũy kuxap hã mõ'hap Topa pu', hu Topa te 'Amanãm max 'ãktux, 'ũyĩpkox xip hah.
Yũmmũg. 'Amanãm kuxa yũm ka'ok Topa kopah, tu' yĩpkox xip, tu hãpxopmãhã kamah.
Yĩy Topa yõg tappet te: 'Amanãm kuxa yũm ka'ok Topa kopah, yĩ' kuxa tupmãhã', pu tu max,” kaxĩy. Ha Topa te 'Amanãm hã' xape'.
Yĩ' yũmmũg. Yã Topa te tikmũ'ũn putup pax, 'ũyõg hãxopmã'ax hãp-tup pax, 'ũkuxa yũm ka'ok ha hãpxopmãhã', ha' kuxa tupmãhã'.
Xotit Ha'ap te 'Iyaet yõg tik xop hã tu tehet, nõm xop te' puknõg yõg hãm pẽnã'ax, ha putat nõy ha' mõgãhã', puyĩy tu nũmãn, yĩy hãpxopmã max, ha Topa tep-tup pax.
Tikmũ'ũn koxuk te' yĩn nĩm, puxix tikmũ'ũn tu xok, hã kaxĩy tikmũ'ũn kuxa yũm ka'ok, tu hãpxopmã hok, puxi' hi xe'e hok.
